name: source-ranking-v1
purpose: Does discover_database put a source that can answer the question in its top 6? Real production catalog (admin view, 25 Nov 2026), real provider ranker; search is what the agent model typically writes. Registers are the rows discovery looks the search up in as a name: the eval fixture's districts and materials, plus the production material the item-code cases name.
